author: Techlore
description:
Building privacy tools used to be neutral technology, now developers are being arrested for it. @NaomiBrockwellTV  breaks down the Samourai Wallet case, the ongoing Roman Storm / Tornado Cash fight, and why privacy can't be won on the tech front alone. The takeaway: legislation, litigation, and technology are all battles we have to fight at the same time.

This is a clip from our full interview with @NaomiBrockwellTV  Watch the complete conversation here: https://youtu.be/0_hlkmpw1sk
